# G2

> > G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace, providing verified user reviews, buyer intent data, and integrations to help businesses discover and purchase software.

G2 connects software buyers and sellers through authentic peer reviews, detailed product comparisons, and data-driven insights. The platform offers tools like Flow Builder for workflow automation, Buyer Intent signals for sales teams, and extensive integrations with platforms like HubSpot to power go-to-market strategies.

## Key Topics

- G2 Marketplace
